cases.prompt: In one sentence, explain what a unit test verifies. Include the words expected behavior.
Explain why API keys should be kept in environment variables or a secret manager. Include the terms secret manager and source control.
Explain why retry loops need a maximum attempt count and timeout. Include maximum attempts and timeout.
Explain why external JSON must be schema-validated before use. Include schema validation and untrusted input.
Explain why an AI system should request approval before a destructive production change. Include human approval and rollback.
